GE Description: On Invoice Correction with a mid-period Price Component Group version change, the Debit note does not split scale lines by PC-group version dates the way the original Standard invoice does. Instead, ZDISTJ / ZDISAH (and likely other scale components) are billed for the full period once per group version, so volumes are doubled.

Example from the ticket:

* Expected ZDISTJ: 10.06–30.06 = 217 + 01.07–09.07 = 93 (total 310)
* Actual ZDISTJ: 10.06–09.07 = 310 twice (total 620)
* Same pattern for ZDISAH: expected 1300, actual 2600

EXPECTED BEHAVIOR (FROM CONFLUENCE + WORKING MAIN INVOICE)

* Invoice correction price-change flow: reverse original, then recalculate via standard billing for the original invoice period
* PC group must be resolved to the version(s) applicable for that billing period
* Debit note detail lines must match the main-invoice split pattern when two PC-group versions fall inside the period
* Volumes must sum to the period total once, not twice

Confluence: [https://asterbit.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/Phoenix/pages/163545113/Invoice+correction+-+process|https://asterbit.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/Phoenix/pages/163545113/Invoice+correction+-+process|smart-link]  (section Group of price components)

Hello, From what I can see, the price components are split in exactly the same way in the main invoice as well.
Could you please clarify what you see as the issue in this case? Is the problem related to the calculation, or is it that the group and its price components are displayed twice?
The problem is that they are not split at all, you can see that the scales ZDISAH and ZDISTJ are billed twice for same period 10.06-09.07
ZDISAH expected volumes for the month 1300, actual volumes 2600
ZDISTJ expected volumes for the month 310, actual volumes 620

the price components in the main invoice are also split by period in the same way. The only difference between the debit invoice and the main invoice is that, in the main invoice, the system calculated the periods 10.06.2026–30.06.2026 and 01.07.2026–09.07.2026 separately based on the group versions. In the debit invoice, however, both periods were calculated together in a single row, resulting in the amount being counted twice. As far as I can tell, the issue is that these periods were not split in the debit invoice the same way they were in the main invoice.
